title: Amazon Web Services IAM user secret access key: one-property twin (length)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 39 characters vs exactly 40, beside the same key name and length: 41 characters vs exactly 40, beside the same key name (the temporary-secret width is not claimed). Twin of "Amazon Web Services IAM user secret access key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of aws-secret-access-key-dotenv: length: 39 characters vs exactly 40, beside the same key name. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
